description: The original aircraft in which Sir Ross Smith, Sir Keith Smith, Sgt J M Bennett and Sgt Wally Shiers made the first England to Australia flight, leaving Hounslow 12 November 1919 and reaching Darwin 28 days later. Restored and displayed inside the airport terminal; volunteer-led tours are run by South Australian Aviation Museum volunteers.
aliases: Vimy; Vimy IV; Vickers Vimy IV; G EAOU
